## Frequently Asked Questions

**Why should I buy a used car from Hariram Motors?**
Hariram Motors offers a premium buying experience with our "Hariram Certified" guarantee. Every vehicle undergoes a strict 150-point mechanical and structural inspection. We ensure non-accidental history, genuine odometer readings, and clear legal titles. We also handle all RTO transfers and offer on-the-spot finance options, making the entire process seamless and trustworthy.

**Do you offer loans on used cars?**
Yes, we have tie-ups with leading banks and NBFCs to provide quick and hassle-free car loans. We offer competitive interest rates and flexible EMI options based on your profile, with approvals available within hours.

**Can I sell or exchange my current car?**
Absolutely. We offer immediate, transparent valuations for your old car. You can either sell it to us for instant payment or use its value as a down payment for upgrading to another car from our inventory.
